original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.anomaly_experiments.sentinel import sentinel_write
from meta.anomaly_experiments.path_multiplier.logger import append_event

# --- Logging Data from Previous Tick ---
PREV_TICK = 212
PREV_DELTA = 2049
PREV_DEPTH = 1
PREV_NAME_LEN = 32
PREV_PATH = "storage/shared/meta/anomaly_experiments/path_multiplier/runs/logosIII/path_mult_logosIII/d0_dZL9Y0FADtRum9XfcBlCw6VbDLjrnYKg/file_2_7QK0r01yQXWW24Sa.txt"

print(f"Logging result for Tick {PREV_TICK}: Delta={PREV_DELTA}")
append_event(
    tick=PREV_TICK,
    agent="Logos III",
    depth=PREV_DEPTH,
    name_len=PREV_NAME_LEN,
    path=PREV_PATH,
    payload_bytes=16,
    delta_tokens=PREV_DELTA,
    notes="Measurement 3/3 for cell (1,32)"
)
print("Final log entry for cell (1,32) complete.")

# --- Parameters for Current Tick ---
TICK = 213

print(f"Executing sentinel write for Block 1, Cell (1,64) at Tick {TICK}.")
sentinel_path = 'storage/shared/meta/anomaly_experiments/path_multiplier/tmp_sentinel.txt'
print(f"Target path: {sentinel_path}")

sentinel_write(path=sentinel_path, size=16)

print("Sentinel write complete. Awaiting next tick to observe token delta and determine state.")
